evidence.producer: PROVISIONAL: src/compiler/module_ir_build.c snapshots Program function/object/ASM/label alias identities into Core ModuleIR, while src/compiler/core_function_set.c creates Source-independent Core FunctionSet and one Core lowering result slot per FunctionId.
consumers: src/compiler/core_reachability.c:minic_core_function_set_close_reachability computes Core/Module-only fixed-point reachability through function/global queues, canonical storage owners, aliases, relocation references, per-block Core CALL/function/global-address instructions and qualified versus opaque GNU inline ASM

src/compiler/core_function_set.c:minic_complete_core_function_set_reachability uses closure verdict to identify a previously skipped source function that became live, lowers it with the same private Core draft transaction, and recomputes until no late-live source function remains
src/compiler/module_ir_build.c:minic_core_module_materialize_live_payloads materializes only closure-live global bytes/fragments after source DataLayout admission and validates independent ModuleIR
src/core/module_ir.c verifies fragment offsets/sizes, symbol uniqueness, object storage extent, and exact correspondence between pre-closure reference edges and emitted relocation fragments
src/compiler/compiler.c performs Core closure -> Core/result validation -> target layout validation -> ModuleIR payload publication -> frees source Program before Target assembly emission
evidence.functional_path: C05 PROVISIONAL responsibility graph: Source AST identity is snapshotted once into ModuleIR and sealed CoreFunctionSet -> module true roots include definitions, file-scope ASM, aliases, global objects, function local-static storage owners and label relocations -> FIFO queue closure traverses live object reference edges and live Core CALL/FUNCTION_ADDRESS/GLOBAL_ADDRESS/INLINE_ASM effects; indirect branches conservatively retain possible blocks -> assign live functions/global emittable flags transactionally -> rerun source-to-Core ingress only for newly live but unattempted source functions, repeat until no new FunctionId -> materialize live global payload and verify ModuleIR before freeing C source state. Not three independent source-level prune passes.
limitations: MAPPING_PROPOSED only; not all Core reachability branches, ASM matcher edge cases, error-injection paths or tests reviewed; no independent control root or semantic-verifier approval.

An assembler mnemonic matching a C function name is NOT necessarily a relocation. Target-qualified operand forms versus opaque ASM intentionally have different conservative handling; cannot delete without GNU behavior comparison.

An unattempted static function and a failed Core lowering are distinct statuses. Initial source emission hints are not authoritative dead-code proof when Core relocation/call/label roots can revive that body.
Global object relocation may refer to assembler spelling resolved to multiple source declarations; canonical owner label relocation retains the original source FunctionBody, not an unrelated clone.
Need exact tests for computed goto, static initializers, file ASM, alias chains, OOM error paths and same-source all-ISA runtime before making any prune simplification.
